name: Ninomiya Nagi
source:
A wealthy transfer student senpai who turns out to be Hiroki's true fiancee: in fact, their parents decided to marry them when they were younger. Because of her strict father, she doesn't have a say in the matter. Nagi falls in love with a boy she met on the way to her fiancée house.

[spoiler] The boy is revealed to be Hiroki. Hiroki is Nagi's first love and later it is revealed that Nagi is Hiroki's first love. [/spoiler]
